env: Requires an Deep Researcher Agent server reachable at DEEP_RESEARCHER_SERVER_URL, defaulting to http://localhost:8000. The server can be started with the deep-researcher-deploy skill before running this eval. This smoke profile intentionally avoids model-generating /chat calls so it can verify the skill wrapper against a live server without consuming model credits.

expects.query: Use the deep-researcher-research skill to check whether the local Deep Researcher Agent server is healthy. Return a concise status and include the server URL you checked.
Use the deep-researcher-research skill to list the available async agent types. Return the result without truncating the JSON keys.
